sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittrellev.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的娜塔莉·基特雷夫。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.

sentences.en: President Trump pushing ahead with sweeping plans to trim the size of the federal government.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统正推进全面计划，以精简联邦政府规模。

sentences.en: President Trump is ramping up deportations in Democrat-led cities.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统正在民主党领导的城市加大驱逐力度。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: has attacked three nuclear sites in Iran.
sentences.zh: 袭击了伊朗的三个核设施。

sentences.en: At the heart of many of President Trump's most controversial policies, there's been one company, Palantir.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普总统许多最具争议的政策核心，一直有一家公司：帕兰提尔（Palantir）。

sentences.en: The core mission of our company always was to make the West, especially America, the strongest in the world, the strongest ever been.
sentences.zh: 我们公司的核心使命始终是让西方，尤其是美国，成为世界上最强大的国家，成为有史以来最强大的国家。

sentences.en: According to Palantir's CEO, the company exists to defend Western ideals.
sentences.zh: 据帕兰提尔首席执行官称，该公司存在的意义是捍卫西方理想。

sentences.en: But to its critics...
sentences.zh: 但对于批评者来说……

sentences.en: Some worry that Palantir could give the government sweeping, almost futuristic surveillance capabilities.
sentences.zh: 有些人担心帕兰提尔可能会赋予政府全面、近乎科幻的监控能力。

sentences.en: Palantir is enabling the administration's illiberal tactics.
sentences.zh: 帕兰提尔正在为政府的非自由主义策略提供支持。

sentences.en: Today, Times contributor Michael Steinberger on how Palantir's CEO, who's described himself as a lifelong Democrat, became a champion of President Trump.
sentences.zh: 今天，《纽约时报》撰稿人迈克尔·斯坦伯格将讲述帕兰提尔的首席执行官——一位自称终身民主党人的人——是如何成为特朗普总统拥护者的。

sentences.en: How his political transformation shaped one of the most secretive companies in the world.
sentences.zh: 他的政治转型如何塑造了这家世界上最神秘的公司之一。

sentences.en: And the impact that transformation could have on American democracy.
sentences.zh: 以及这种转型可能对美国民主产生的影响。

sentences.en: Palantir is here to disrupt and make the institutions we partner with the very best in the world.
sentences.zh: 帕兰提尔的存在是为了颠覆，并让我们合作的机构成为世界上最优秀的机构。

sentences.en: And when it's necessary to scare enemies and on occasion kill them.
sentences.zh: 并在必要时威慑敌人，有时甚至消灭他们。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, December 16th.
sentences.zh: 今天是12月16日，星期二。

sentences.en: Michael, welcome to the show.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，欢迎来到节目。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: You just published this book.
sentences.zh: 你刚刚出版了这本书。

sentences.en: It's called The Philosopher in the Valley, about Palantir and its CEO, Alex Karp.
sentences.zh: 书名叫《硅谷哲学家》，讲述的是帕兰提尔及其首席执行官亚历克斯·卡普。

sentences.en: And in the process of working on that book, you spent a lot of time with Karp and inside the company.
sentences.zh: 在创作这本书的过程中，你花了很多时间与卡普相处，并深入了解了这家公司。

sentences.en: This company that is playing a very unique role in the second Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 这家公司在第二届特朗普政府中扮演着非常独特的角色。

sentences.en: So, I can't think of anyone better to ask.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想不出比你更好的人选来问这个问题。

sentences.en: What exactly does Palantir do?
sentences.zh: 帕兰提尔到底是做什么的？

sentences.en: Well, first, I should say that it's a quite secretive company.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先我得说，这是一家相当神秘的公司。

sentences.en: A lot of its work is done with intelligence services, the military.
sentences.zh: 它的很多工作都是与情报部门和军方合作完成的。

sentences.en: So, there's a lot of stuff they do that they can't talk about that we can't know about.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们做的很多事情我们无法谈论，也无法知晓。

sentences.en: The work is also technologically quite complex.
sentences.zh: 这项工作在技术上也相当复杂。

sentences.en: Essentially, Palantir makes software that enables organizations to make faster, better use of their data.
sentences.zh: 本质上，帕兰提尔制造的软件能让组织更快、更好地利用他们的数据。

sentences.en: Typically, we're talking about large organizations that collect sizable quantities of data.
sentences.zh: 通常我们指的是那些收集大量数据的大型组织。

sentences.en: The Palantir software pulls in all the data, merges it, and then finds patterns, trends, connections in that data.
sentences.zh: 帕兰提尔的软件会汇入所有数据，进行合并，然后从中发现模式、趋势和关联。

sentences.en: Stuff that might elude the human eye.
sentences.zh: 那些肉眼可能无法察觉的东西。

sentences.en: One very powerful example of Palantir's work was in the war in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 帕兰提尔工作的一个非常有力的例子是在乌克兰战争中。

sentences.en: Palantir's software is the backbone for the Pentagon's AI-driven targeting program.
sentences.zh: 帕兰提尔的软件是五角大楼人工智能驱动的目标定位项目的骨干。

sentences.en: And this was used extensively in the first months of the war to help the Ukrainians withstand the Russian assault.
sentences.zh: 在战争初期，它被广泛用于帮助乌克兰人抵御俄罗斯的进攻。

sentences.en: So, a lot of satellite data was being pulled in by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 当时，美国军方汇集了大量卫星数据，

sentences.en: military, along with intercepted Russian communications.
sentences.zh: 以及截获的俄罗斯通信信息。

sentences.en: And the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: military was able to say to the Ukrainians, okay, here's where there's a troop formation, there's a general here.
sentences.zh: 军方能够告诉乌克兰人：好的，这里有部队集结，这里有一位将军。

sentences.en: If you fire a missile at these coordinates, you might be very happy with the results.
sentences.zh: 如果你向这些坐标发射导弹，你可能会对结果非常满意。

sentences.en: And Palantir's technology was instrumental to this and played a very significant role in enabling the Ukrainians to withstand the initial Russian assault.
sentences.zh: 帕兰提尔的技术对此起到了关键作用，在帮助乌克兰人抵御俄罗斯最初的进攻方面发挥了极其重要的作用。

sentences.en: So, that example of the war in Ukraine obviously shows the value of this software.
sentences.zh: 所以，乌克兰战争的那个例子显然展示了这种软件的价值。

sentences.en: But this is a company that also prompts a lot of concern, right?
sentences.zh: 但这也是一家引起了很多担忧的公司，对吧？

sentences.en: Can you just explain that part?
sentences.zh: 你能解释一下那部分吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, it not only prompts a lot of concern, many people regard Palantir as possibly the most dangerous company in the world.
sentences.zh: 是的，它不仅引起了很多担忧，许多人甚至认为帕兰提尔可能是世界上最危险的公司。

sentences.en: Part of this is some of the clients it has.
sentences.zh: 部分原因在于它的一些客户。

sentences.en: It's used by the CIA.
sentences.zh: 它被中央情报局（CIA）使用。

sentences.en: In fact, the CIA was an early investor in Palantir.
sentences.zh: 事实上，中情局是帕兰提尔的早期投资者。

sentences.en: It's also used by the Mossad and other clandestine services.
sentences.zh: 它也被摩萨德和其他秘密情报机构使用。

sentences.en: It's used extensively by law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 它被执法部门广泛使用。

sentences.en: A lot of personal information is flowing through Palantir's pipelines.
sentences.zh: 大量个人信息正在通过帕兰提尔的管道流动。

sentences.en: And the company has also been at the center of the issues that have dominated the headlines this year and have generated a lot of controversy.
sentences.zh: 而且该公司也一直处于今年占据头条新闻并引发巨大争议的问题中心。

sentences.en: ICE and deportations, Doge, Gaza, Iran, and AI.
sentences.zh: 移民与海关执法局（ICE）和驱逐行动、Doge（政府效率部）、加沙、伊朗和人工智能。

sentences.en: Can you just go a little deeper on one of those examples?
sentences.zh: 你能就其中一个例子深入讲讲吗？

sentences.en: Like, how has it been at the center of things?
sentences.zh: 比如，它是如何处于这些事情中心的？

sentences.en: Well, for instance, Palantir's technology is integral to the immigration crackdown taking place right now.
sentences.zh: 嗯，例如，帕兰提尔的技术对于目前正在进行的移民打击行动至关重要。

sentences.en: ICE is making extensive use of Palantir's technology to identify and facilitate deportations.
sentences.zh: ICE正在广泛使用帕兰提尔的技术来识别并协助驱逐行动。

sentences.en: And what has people particularly concerned is that ICE appears to be building a massive surveillance apparatus.
sentences.zh: 让人们特别担心的是，ICE似乎正在建立一个大规模的监控系统。

sentences.en: And Palantir appears to be at the center of that.
sentences.zh: 而帕兰提尔似乎正处于这个系统的中心。

sentences.en: Now, Palantir sees itself as a force for good in the world.
sentences.zh: 现在，帕兰提尔将自己视为世界上一股向善的力量。

sentences.en: But even people at the company acknowledge that its technology could be used to do harm.
sentences.zh: 但即使是公司内部的人也承认，其技术可能被用于作恶。

sentences.en: And it's been clear for some time that its technology in the hands of an authoritarian regime would be a very powerful tool.
sentences.zh: 而且很长一段时间以来人们都很清楚，如果其技术落入威权政权手中，将成为一种极其强大的工具。

sentences.en: And who gets to use Palantir's software and for what purpose is decided by one person, the company's CEO, Alex Karp.
sentences.zh: 谁可以使用帕兰提尔的软件以及用于什么目的，是由一个人决定的，那就是公司首席执行官亚历克斯·卡普。

sentences.en: Tell me about Alex Karp.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说亚历克斯·卡普吧。

sentences.en: Who is he?
sentences.zh: 他是谁？

sentences.en: Alex Karp is maybe the most unique figure on the global business scene.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯·卡普可能是全球商业舞台上最独特的人物。

sentences.en: He and I first started talking in 2019.
sentences.zh: 我和他是在2019年开始交谈的。

sentences.en: We had a couple conversations that year, including one at a home that he owns in Vermont.
sentences.zh: 那一年我们进行了几次谈话，包括在他位于佛蒙特州的一处住所里。

sentences.en: So you just found this place?
sentences.zh: 所以你刚找到这个地方？

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: It's a little bit of a dump, but I like it.
sentences.zh: 这地方有点破，但我喜欢。

sentences.en: It's nice.
sentences.zh: 挺好的。

sentences.en: To say the home was off the grid would be an understatement.
sentences.zh: 说这个家与世隔绝都算是轻描淡写了。

sentences.en: I'm happy with it.
sentences.zh: 我很满意。

sentences.en: I like it.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢它。

sentences.en: And I mean, you've got privacy here.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你在这里有隐私。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You know, my neighbors, I don't know if you saw the neighbors there.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我的邻居，不知道你有没有看到那边的邻居。

sentences.en: Like we have a farmer to the left here?
sentences.zh: 比如我们左边有个农民？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We had a conversation over lunch, but it's difficult for Karp to sit still.
sentences.zh: 我们午餐时聊了聊，但卡普很难坐得住。

sentences.en: And as soon as we were finished...
sentences.zh: 我们刚聊完……

sentences.en: You know, why don't we go for a walk-in and I'll tell you about this.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们为什么不去散散步，我再跟你讲讲这个。

sentences.en: We took a long hike.
sentences.zh: 我们进行了一次长途徒步。

sentences.en: We were trailed by two of his bodyguards.
sentences.zh: 我们身后跟着他的两名保镖。

sentences.en: We've got the bodyguards with us again.
sentences.zh: 我们又带着保镖了。

sentences.en: And two more bodyguards remained in the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 还有两名保镖留在停车场。

sentences.en: If my phone's around, someone's listening.
sentences.zh: 如果我的手机在附近，就有人在监听。

sentences.en: Someone is listening.
sentences.zh: 有人在监听。

sentences.en: Definitively.
sentences.zh: 肯定的。

sentences.en: So, a foreign intelligence agency?
sentences.zh: 所以，是外国情报机构？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: We'd be irresponsible for them not to listen to Mark and Karp.
sentences.zh: 如果他们不监听马克和卡普，那才是不负责任。

sentences.en: So, the conversation...
sentences.zh: 所以，谈话……

sentences.en: He's very security conscious, and for a good reason.
sentences.zh: 他非常有安全意识，而且是有充分理由的。

sentences.en: He's running a company that works with the CIA and other clandestine services that is a major defense contractor.
sentences.zh: 他经营着一家与中情局和其他秘密情报机构合作的公司，而且是一家主要的国防承包商。

sentences.en: Do you worry about your personal safety?
sentences.zh: 你担心你的人身安全吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对担心。

sentences.en: You do, yeah.
sentences.zh: 你担心，是吧。

sentences.en: I'd be insane not to.
sentences.zh: 如果不担心，我就是疯了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, when they got me, the bodyguards, I thought I was insane.
sentences.zh: 我是说，当他们给我配保镖时，我觉得自己疯了。

sentences.en: But now, I think it's prescient, because historically, we've gotten lots of threats from, like, far-right neo-nostics.
sentences.zh: 但现在，我觉得这很有先见之明，因为从历史上看，我们收到过很多来自极右翼新纳粹分子的威胁。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Now, I mean, it's like, people who hate us come in many different stripes.
sentences.zh: 现在，我是说，讨厌我们的人形形色色。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: He's had a very unusual path to this role.
sentences.zh: 他走上这个职位的道路非常不寻常。

sentences.en: And what is that path?
sentences.zh: 那条路是什么样的？

sentences.en: He's a Philly kid.
sentences.zh: 他是费城长大的孩子。

sentences.en: He grew up in Philadelphia.
sentences.zh: 他在费城长大。

sentences.en: He grew up in a very left-wing household.
sentences.zh: 他在一个非常左翼的家庭中长大。

sentences.en: His father is a Jewish pediatrician.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲是一位犹太儿科医生。

sentences.en: His mother is black and an artiSt.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲是黑人，也是一位艺术家。

sentences.en: He's biracial, Jewish, and also severely dyslexic.
sentences.zh: 他是混血儿，犹太人，而且有严重的阅读障碍。

sentences.en: It's like, I have this weirdly structured brain.
sentences.zh: 就像是，我的大脑结构很奇怪。

sentences.en: The motor is just structured differently.
sentences.zh: 引擎的结构就是不一样。

sentences.en: And Karp and his brother, who's two years younger, spent a lot of time going to anti-war protests, anti-nuclear protests.
sentences.zh: 卡普和他小两岁的弟弟花了很多时间去参加反战抗议、反核抗议。

sentences.en: And he ends up going to college locally, to Haverford College, a small liberal arts school with a strong tradition of dissent.
sentences.zh: 后来他就在当地上了大学，去了哈弗福德学院，这是一所拥有强烈异见传统的小型文理学院。

sentences.en: Perfect place for someone who grew up in the political milieu that Karp did.
sentences.zh: 对于像卡普这样在那种政治环境中长大的人来说，这里是完美的地方。

sentences.en: I should acknowledge at this point that he and I were classmates at Haverford.
sentences.zh: 我应该承认，我和他是哈弗福德的同学。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太神奇了。

sentences.en: I should acknowledge at this point that I grew up on Haverford College's campus because my parents taught there.
sentences.zh: 我应该承认，我是在哈弗福德学院的校园里长大的，因为我父母在那里教书。

sentences.en: Haverford's a small place, but it is converging in this moment here, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 哈弗福德是个小地方，但此刻在这里交汇了，不是吗？

sentences.en: Indeed.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: So, in any event, he insists that he didn't work that hard at Haverford.
sentences.zh: 总之，他坚持说他在哈弗福德没那么努力学习。

sentences.en: I think his path in life would suggest otherwise.
sentences.zh: 我想他的人生道路会说明事实并非如此。

sentences.en: I think the library saw a lot more of him than it did of me, which may go some way to explaining why he became a billionaire and I did not.
sentences.zh: 我觉得图书馆见他的次数比见我多得多，这或许能解释为什么他成了亿万富翁，而我没有。

sentences.en: But as a young man, he identified very strongly with his black heritage.
sentences.zh: 但作为年轻人，他对自己黑人血统的认同感非常强烈。

sentences.en: At Haverford, he was very involved with black student affairs.
sentences.zh: 在哈弗福德，他非常积极地参与黑人学生事务。

sentences.en: In our senior year in college, he helped organize an anti-racism conference at Yale University.
sentences.zh: 大学四年级时，他协助组织了耶鲁大学的一次反种族主义会议。

sentences.en: After Haverford, he goes to Stanford Law School, which he considers one of the biggest mistakes of his life.
sentences.zh: 哈弗福德毕业后，他去了斯坦福法学院，他认为那是他一生中最大的错误之一。

sentences.en: I just hated it.
sentences.zh: 我简直讨厌死那里了。

sentences.en: He's miserable there.
sentences.zh: 他在那里过得很痛苦。

sentences.en: He finds the intellectual climate very dissatisfying.
sentences.zh: 他觉得那里的学术氛围非常令人不满。

sentences.en: The only thing that makes law school tolerable for Karp is the friendship he strikes up with another first-year law student at Stanford, Peter Thiel.
sentences.zh: 卡普在法学院唯一能忍受的事情，就是他与另一位斯坦福一年级法学生彼得·蒂尔建立的友谊。

sentences.en: Peter Thiel, the now very prominent libertarian conservative, now a big Republican donor.
sentences.zh: 彼得·蒂尔，如今非常著名的自由意志主义保守派，现在是一位共和党大金主。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They bonded over their shared dislike of law school, and they also bonded over their love of political argument.
sentences.zh: 他们因对法学院的共同厌恶而结缘，也因对政治辩论的热爱而走到了一起。

sentences.en: As Thiel said to me, he was more the capitalist and Karp was the socialiSt.
sentences.zh: 正如蒂尔对我所说，他更倾向于资本主义，而卡普则是社会主义者。

sentences.en: We've been having these feral discourses now for 25, 26 years.
sentences.zh: 我们进行这种野性十足的探讨已经有25、26年了。

sentences.en: Karp says that they argued like feral animals.
sentences.zh: 卡普说他们争论起来就像野兽一样。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: These dorm room bull sessions were apparently epic.
sentences.zh: 这些宿舍里的激烈辩论显然非常精彩。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: They had their own little debate club.
sentences.zh: 他们有自己的小型辩论俱乐部。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: So, you know, Karp and Thiel graduated from Stanford Law in 1992.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，卡普和蒂尔于1992年从斯坦福法学院毕业。

sentences.en: Karp had no intention of pursuing a career in law.
sentences.zh: 卡普无意从事法律职业。

sentences.en: Instead, he went to Germany to pursue a doctorate in philosophy.
sentences.zh: 相反，他去了德国攻读哲学博士学位。

sentences.en: But I became myself in my adolescence in Germany.
sentences.zh: 但在德国的青春期，我才真正成为了我自己。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I'd say, which means, like, I was able to expand into my true self.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，这意味着我能够扩展出真实的自我。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Or the self I was most comfortable with.
sentences.zh: 或者说是我感到最自在的那个自我。

sentences.en: Gotcha.
sentences.zh: 懂了。

sentences.en: He went to Germany because he was, you know, the writers that he found most impactful were German.
sentences.zh: 他去德国是因为，你知道，他发现对他影响最深的作家都是德国人。

sentences.en: But he was also drawn there because he was Jewish.
sentences.zh: 但他被吸引过去也是因为他是犹太人。

sentences.en: His father's family had come from Germany.
sentences.zh: 他父亲的家族来自德国。

sentences.en: And he wanted to gain a deeper understanding of the Holocaust and why Germany, which had been the pinnacle of European civilization,
sentences.zh: 他想更深入地了解大屠杀，以及为什么曾经作为欧洲文明巅峰的德国，

sentences.en: descended into such barbarism and turned on its Jewish population so savagely.
sentences.zh: 会堕落到如此野蛮的地步，并如此残忍地对待其犹太人口。

sentences.en: And he ends up writing his dissertation on the rhetoric of fascism.
sentences.zh: 最终他写了一篇关于法西斯主义修辞的论文。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Peter Thiel is back in the United States.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，彼得·蒂尔回到了美国。

sentences.en: He works for a time for a New York law firm, then ends up working at an investment bank.
sentences.zh: 他曾在一家纽约律师事务所工作过一段时间，后来又去了一家投资银行。

sentences.en: Unsatisfied with that, he heads back out to Silicon Valley, where the dot-com boom is underway, and co-founds an online payments company, PayPal, in 1998.
sentences.zh: 由于对现状不满，他回到了硅谷，当时正值互联网泡沫时期，并于1998年联合创办了一家在线支付公司——PayPal。

sentences.en: Three years later, the world changes.
sentences.zh: 三年后，世界变了。

sentences.en: Just a few moments ago, allegedly a plane has crashed into the World Trade Center.
sentences.zh: 就在几分钟前，据称有一架飞机撞向了世界贸易中心。

sentences.en: When 9-11 happens.
sentences.zh: 当9·11事件发生时。

sentences.en: Oh, there's another one.
sentences.zh: 哦，又来了一架。

sentences.en: Another plane just hit.
sentences.zh: 又有一架飞机撞上了。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Another plane.
sentences.zh: 又一架飞机。

sentences.en: The unthinkable happened today.
sentences.zh: 今天发生了不可思议的事情。

sentences.en: The World Trade Center, both towers, gone.
sentences.zh: 世界贸易中心，两座大楼，都没了。

sentences.en: The American people want the answers to so many questions around 9-11.
sentences.zh: 美国人民想知道关于9·11的许多问题的答案。

sentences.en: Thiel wonders if the attack could have been prevented had government agencies been able to more readily share information with one another.
sentences.zh: 蒂尔想知道，如果政府机构能够更顺畅地共享信息，这次袭击是否本可以避免。

sentences.en: The FBI had information.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局有信息。

sentences.en: The CIA had information.
sentences.zh: 中央情报局有信息。

sentences.en: If that information had been pooled, it's possible the attack could have been prevented.
sentences.zh: 如果这些信息能汇总起来，袭击是有可能被阻止的。

sentences.en: The 9-11 Commission, when it issued its final report in 2004, said that there had been a failure to connect the dots, in part because information was siloed.
sentences.zh: 9·11委员会在2004年发布最终报告时表示，未能将各条线索串联起来，部分原因是信息被孤立了。

sentences.en: And this is the idea that gives rise to Palantir.
sentences.zh: 正是这个想法催生了Palantir。

sentences.en: Thiel believed he could create a company that would help intelligence analysts connect the dots, find the needles in the haystack, and prevent future attacks.
sentences.zh: 蒂尔相信他可以创建一家公司，帮助情报分析师串联线索，在大海捞针中找到目标，并防止未来的袭击。

sentences.en: And it's around this time that Karp resurfaces in the Bay Area.
sentences.zh: 大约就在这个时候，卡普在湾区重新露面了。

sentences.en: He's back from Germany, and he and Thiel reunite.
sentences.zh: 他从德国回来了，他和蒂尔重聚了。

sentences.en: Thiel asks Karp to help him raise some money for Palantir.
sentences.zh: 蒂尔请卡普帮他为Palantir筹集资金。

sentences.en: This company's trying to get off the ground.
sentences.zh: 这家公司正试图起步。

sentences.en: Thiel interviews a couple of people for the CEO position.
sentences.zh: 蒂尔面试了几个人选来担任首席执行官。

sentences.en: But then he and the other people involved in founding Palantir realize Karp is probably the right guy for the job.
sentences.zh: 但后来他和Palantir的其他创始成员意识到，卡普可能才是最合适的人选。

sentences.en: Can you say why?
sentences.zh: 你能说说为什么吗？

sentences.en: Because Karp actually seems to me an unlikely pick to be CEO.
sentences.zh: 因为在我看来，卡普确实不太像是担任CEO的人选。

sentences.en: He isn't really in the Silicon Valley tech scene at this point, right?
sentences.zh: 他当时并不在硅谷的科技圈里，对吧？

sentences.en: No, he's not.
sentences.zh: 不，他不在。

sentences.en: I mean, in some ways, he's a very unlikely choice, and he admitted as much to me.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在某些方面，他是一个非常出人意料的选择，他也向我承认了这一点。

sentences.en: I had no skills.
sentences.zh: 我没有任何技能。

sentences.en: That's the truth.
sentences.zh: 这是事实。

sentences.en: I wasn't trained in business.
sentences.zh: 我没有受过商业培训。

sentences.en: I didn't know anything about startup culture.
sentences.zh: 我对创业文化一无所知。

sentences.en: I didn't know anything about building a business.
sentences.zh: 我对建立企业一无所知。

sentences.en: I didn't know anything about financing a business.
sentences.zh: 我对企业融资一无所知。

sentences.en: He's got no background in business, no training in computer science, and of course, he's coming from a left-wing household,
sentences.zh: 他没有商业背景，没有受过计算机科学训练，而且当然，他来自一个左翼家庭，

sentences.en: and now he's going to be working for a company that's at the nexus of technology in the national security state.
sentences.zh: 现在他却要为一家处于国家安全技术核心的公司工作。

sentences.en: He is, yeah, on paper, a very unlikely fit, and yet he is very passionate.
sentences.zh: 是的，从纸面上看，他确实非常不合适，但他非常有激情。

sentences.en: I mean, the moment he gets involved, he is very passionate about what Palantir is doing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，从他加入的那一刻起，他就对Palantir所做的事情充满了热情。

sentences.en: I just thought this sounds like the coolest idea ever.
sentences.zh: 我当时就觉得这听起来是有史以来最酷的想法。

sentences.en: You thought, yeah, so.
sentences.zh: 你当时想，是啊，所以。

sentences.en: So if I pass this up, I'll regret it.
sentences.zh: 如果我错过了这个机会，我会后悔的。

sentences.en: What exactly about what Palantir is up to at this point is Karp passionate about?
sentences.zh: 卡普对Palantir当时所做的事情究竟有什么热情？

sentences.en: Well, Palantir is this rare burden that's a very ideological company.
sentences.zh: 嗯，Palantir是一家罕见的、非常有意识形态的公司。

sentences.en: It doesn't exist just to help the U.S.
sentences.zh: 它存在的目的不仅仅是为了帮助美国

sentences.en: government fight the war on terrorism, but it exists more broadly to help defend the WeSt.
sentences.zh: 政府打击恐怖主义，更广泛地说，它是为了帮助捍卫西方。

sentences.en: That is their view, and he's passionate about this, defending the West, but also defending what he sees as core Western values,
sentences.zh: 这就是他们的观点，他对此充满热情，捍卫西方，同时也捍卫他所认为的核心西方价值观，

sentences.en: freedom of speech, freedom of assembly, freedom of religion, what we know as civil liberties.
sentences.zh: 言论自由、集会自由、宗教自由，也就是我们所知的公民自由。

sentences.en: He believed that Palantir could develop technology that would enable the government to find the bad guys without becoming a massive dragnet pulling in lots of innocent Americans.
sentences.zh: 他相信Palantir可以开发出一种技术，使政府能够在不进行大规模搜捕、不牵连大量无辜美国人的情况下找到坏人。

sentences.en: And he's drawn to Palantir's mission for very personal reasons, reasons that are tied to his own identity.
sentences.zh: 他被Palantir的使命所吸引，有着非常个人的原因，这些原因与他自己的身份认同有关。

sentences.en: If you're me, and you wake up every morning, like I still do, thinking, I am totally screwed.
sentences.zh: 如果你是我，每天早上醒来，就像我现在依然做的那样，心想：我彻底完了。

sentences.en: That's how I wake up every morning.
sentences.zh: 我每天早上醒来都是这种感觉。

sentences.en: That's how I've been waking up every morning my whole life.
sentences.zh: 我这辈子每天早上醒来都是这种感觉。

sentences.en: You wake up every morning thinking I'm totally screwed?
sentences.zh: 你每天早上醒来都觉得我彻底完了？

sentences.en: Yeah, because...
sentences.zh: 是的，因为……

sentences.en: He understands from a young age, he says, that he had, in his view, some strikes against him.
sentences.zh: 他说他从小就明白，在他看来，自己身上有一些不利因素。

sentences.en: And I am this racially amorphous Jewish kid who's also dyslexic.
sentences.zh: 我是一个种族模糊的犹太孩子，还有阅读障碍。

sentences.en: I am fucked.
sentences.zh: 我完蛋了。

sentences.en: That's how I see myself.
sentences.zh: 我就是这样看待自己的。

sentences.en: That's how I saw myself.
sentences.zh: 我曾经就是这样看待自己的。

sentences.en: And it's a sense of vulnerability he carries into adulthood and brings with him to Palantir.
sentences.zh: 这种脆弱感一直伴随着他进入成年，并被他带到了Palantir。

sentences.en: There's no aspect of my life that was not motivated by absolute terror.
sentences.zh: 我生活中没有任何方面不是由绝对的恐惧所驱动的。

sentences.en: That propelled almost every decision.
sentences.zh: 这推动了几乎每一个决定。

sentences.en: It propels a lot of decisions for this company.
sentences.zh: 它也推动了这家公司的许多决定。

sentences.en: And I don't have less of it than I did when I was a little kid.
sentences.zh: 而且我现在的恐惧感并不比小时候少。

sentences.en: And in the aftermath of 9-11, there was obviously a lot of concern that there were going to be many more terrorist attacks.
sentences.zh: 在9·11事件之后，显然人们非常担心还会发生更多的恐怖袭击。

sentences.en: And Carp's view is that when people feel threatened, whether because of crime or because of terrorism, they inevitably turn to the far right.
sentences.zh: 卡普的观点是，当人们感到受到威胁时，无论是出于犯罪还是恐怖主义，他们不可避免地会转向极右翼。

sentences.en: And why do I care about the ascendancy of the far right?
sentences.zh: 为什么我关心极右翼的崛起？

sentences.en: Because who's the first person who's going to get hung when they come to power?
sentences.zh: 因为当他们掌权时，谁是第一个被绞死的人？

sentences.en: By the way, the far, far, far, far, far left isn't much better either.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，极左翼也好不到哪去。

sentences.en: You make a list and I will show you who they get firSt.
sentences.zh: 你列个名单，我会告诉你他们先对付谁。

sentences.en: It's me.
sentences.zh: 那就是我。

sentences.en: And he wants to prevent that because liberal democracy, robust protection of minority rights, these are things that matter greatly to him personally.
sentences.zh: 他想阻止这种情况，因为自由民主、对少数群体权利的有力保护，这些对他个人来说非常重要。

sentences.en: And so he sees Palantir as a way of possibly preventing that political outcome.
sentences.zh: 因此，他将Palantir视为一种可能防止这种政治结果的方式。

sentences.en: It's interesting.
sentences.zh: 很有意思。

sentences.en: He views preventing terrorist attacks as key to preventing the American public from turning to the far right out of fear.
sentences.zh: 他认为防止恐怖袭击是防止美国公众因恐惧而转向极右翼的关键。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He thought that if there were more terrorist attacks and many more mass casualty events because of terrorism,
sentences.zh: 他认为，如果发生更多的恐怖袭击和更多因恐怖主义造成的大规模伤亡事件，

sentences.en: voters were inevitably going to turn to the far right because they think that the far right will protect them
sentences.zh: 选民不可避免地会转向极右翼，因为他们认为极右翼会保护他们，

sentences.en: and they will become much less inclined to protect minorities and so forth because they're scared and they want protection and they think the far right will protect them.
sentences.zh: 而且他们会变得更不愿意保护少数群体等等，因为他们害怕，他们想要保护，他们认为极右翼会保护他们。

sentences.en: They will turn to authoritarianism.
sentences.zh: 他们会转向威权主义。

sentences.en: He wants to prevent that outcome.
sentences.zh: 他想阻止这种结果。

sentences.en: And he sees Palantir as a means possibly of helping prevent that.
sentences.zh: 他将Palantir视为可能有助于防止这种情况的一种手段。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And how does this ideological bent, this commitment to defending the West, actually manifest in Palantir's work?
sentences.zh: 这种意识形态倾向，这种捍卫西方的承诺，实际上是如何在Palantir的工作中体现出来的？

sentences.en: Well, it begins with the CIA, which becomes a Palantir client.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这始于中央情报局，它成为了Palantir的客户。

sentences.en: They then develop a business with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 然后他们与美国

sentences.en: military.
sentences.zh: 军方开展了业务。

sentences.en: This is very much in keeping with their mission.
sentences.zh: 这非常符合他们的使命。

sentences.en: They want to be the software supplier of choice to the national security state.
sentences.zh: 他们想成为国家安全部门首选的软件供应商。

sentences.en: But then in the 2010s, they start developing business on the civilian side of the federal government with a number of government agencies, including ICE.
sentences.zh: 但在2010年代，他们开始在联邦政府的民用部门开展业务，与包括移民及海关执法局（ICE）在内的多个政府机构合作。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And this contract becomes a flashpoint for Palantir, the most controversial part of Palantir's work for the government.
sentences.zh: 这份合同成为了Palantir的一个焦点，也是Palantir为政府工作中最具争议的部分。

sentences.en: And what is Palantir doing for ICE, at least at the beginning?
sentences.zh: 至少在最初，Palantir为ICE做了什么？

sentences.en: Well, it's a relationship that began actually under the Obama administration.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这段关系实际上始于奥巴马政府时期。

sentences.en: A lot of Palantir's work begins with clients in moments of crisis.
sentences.zh: Palantir的许多工作都是从危机时刻的客户开始的。

sentences.en: And ICE had a crisis on its hands.
sentences.zh: 而ICE当时正面临一场危机。

sentences.en: And now news about the shooting of two Americans south of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 现在有关于两名美国人在美国南部

sentences.en: border in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 边境墨西哥境内被枪击的消息。

sentences.en: One Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent killed another wounded.
sentences.zh: 一名移民及海关执法局特工死亡，另一名受伤。

sentences.en: And ICE special agent had been assassinated by a Mexican drug cartel.
sentences.zh: 一名ICE特别探员被墨西哥贩毒集团暗杀。

sentences.en: The driver, Special Agent Jaime Zapata, was shot several times in the chest and killed.
sentences.zh: 司机，特别探员杰米·萨帕塔，胸部中弹数次身亡。

sentences.en: And ICE needed help finding the assassins.
sentences.zh: ICE需要帮助寻找凶手。

sentences.en: There's an intense manhunt underway in Mexico right now for the killers of an American immigration officer, both U.S.
sentences.zh: 目前墨西哥正在对一名美国移民官员的杀手进行大规模搜捕，美国

sentences.en: and Mexican investigators involved.
sentences.zh: 和墨西哥的调查人员都参与其中。

sentences.en: And he turned to Palantir, and within a matter of hours, Palantir engineers had the software up and running for ICE
sentences.zh: 他求助于Palantir，在几个小时内，Palantir的工程师就为ICE运行了软件，

sentences.en: and were pulling in a wide variety of data, including phone records, bank records, any footage that might have been pulled from surveillance cameras.
sentences.zh: 并开始调取各种数据，包括电话记录、银行记录，以及任何可能从监控摄像头获取的录像。

sentences.en: And within two weeks...
sentences.zh: 两周之内……

sentences.en: After Jaime Zapata was laid to rest yesterday,
sentences.zh: 在杰米·萨帕塔昨天入土为安后，

sentences.en: Mexican authorities took one of the suspects into custody today.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥当局今天拘留了一名嫌疑人。

sentences.en: They had apprehended the assailant and also confiscated millions of dollars' worth of drugs.
sentences.zh: 他们抓获了袭击者，并没收了价值数百万美元的毒品。

sentences.en: After that, ICE awards Palantir a contract in 2014, working with a branch of ICE called Homeland Security Investigations,
sentences.zh: 此后，ICE在2014年授予Palantir一份合同，与ICE下属的国土安全调查处合作，

sentences.en: which deals with things like human trafficking and drug trafficking.
sentences.zh: 该部门处理人口贩运和毒品贩运等事务。

sentences.en: It's a relationship that doesn't draw much attention until Donald Trump has elected president the first time in 2016.
sentences.zh: 这段关系在唐纳德·特朗普2016年首次当选总统之前并没有引起太多关注。

sentences.en: He had run on a promise to crack down on immigration, and ICE is instrumental to enforcing that crackdown,
sentences.zh: 他竞选时承诺要打击非法移民，而ICE在执行这一打击行动中起到了关键作用，

sentences.en: and Palantir becomes the object of protests because of its relationship with ICE.
sentences.zh: Palantir也因为与ICE的关系而成为了抗议的对象。

sentences.en: How so?
sentences.zh: 怎么说？

sentences.en: There are protests outside its headquarters in Palo Alto and outside other Palantir offices.
sentences.zh: 在其帕洛阿尔托总部外和其他Palantir办公室外都有抗议活动。

sentences.en: Protesters held signs like,
sentences.zh: 抗议者举着标语，写着：

sentences.en: Palantir, wake up, you're complicit.
sentences.zh: Palantir，醒醒，你是共犯。

sentences.en: There are boycotts on campuses, people saying that they don't want Palantir's recruiters to appear on their campuses.
sentences.zh: 校园里出现了抵制活动，人们表示不希望Palantir的招聘人员出现在他们的校园里。

sentences.en: Palantir is kicked out of several major tech conferences because people don't want it there.
sentences.zh: Palantir 被几家大型科技会议拒之门外，因为人们不欢迎它。

sentences.en: And there is also a fair amount of internal dissent.
sentences.zh: 而且公司内部也存在相当多的异议。

sentences.en: There are hundreds of employees at Palantir who make known their objection to working with ICE and to having any role in Trump's immigration crackdown.
sentences.zh: Palantir 有数百名员工公开反对与美国移民及海关执法局（ICE）合作，并反对在特朗普的移民打压行动中扮演任何角色。

sentences.en: I'm interested.
sentences.zh: 我很有兴趣。

sentences.en: How does Karp, this one-time activist himself, this son of leftists, how does he respond to the outcry on the left over this contract?
sentences.zh: 卡普本人曾是一位活动家，也是左翼人士之子，他如何回应左翼对此合同的强烈抗议？

sentences.en: Well, he makes clear back in Trump's first presidency that he is not a fan of Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他在特朗普第一个总统任期内就明确表示，他不是唐纳德·特朗普的粉丝。

sentences.en: I understand why the protesters protest us.
sentences.zh: 我理解抗议者为什么要抗议我们。

sentences.en: I grew up protesting people.
sentences.zh: 我就是在抗议声中长大的。

sentences.en: But he also thinks that the protesters and Democrats more broadly are very misguided on the issue of immigration.
sentences.zh: 但他同时也认为，抗议者和更广泛的民主党人在移民问题上非常误入歧途。

sentences.en: And, you know, I am a progressive, and many progressives believe that we should have strong border enforcement.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我是一个进步派，许多进步派人士也认为我们应该加强边境执法。

sentences.en: So that's going to be part of the progressive tent if we progressives want to win.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我们进步派想要获胜，这就必须成为进步派阵营的一部分。

sentences.en: Voters are not happy about scenes of chaos at the border.
sentences.zh: 选民们对边境的混乱景象感到不满。

sentences.en: They don't like illegal immigration because they think that it would depress the wages of working-class Americans.
sentences.zh: 他们不喜欢非法移民，因为他们认为这会压低美国工薪阶层的工资。

sentences.en: And Karp's view is that if Democrats and progressives don't take those concerns seriously, they're going to turn to people who do.
sentences.zh: 卡普的观点是，如果民主党人和进步派不认真对待这些担忧，选民就会转向那些重视这些问题的人。

sentences.en: That's why Donald Trump was elected in 2016, in Karp's view.
sentences.zh: 在卡普看来，这就是唐纳德·特朗普在 2016 年当选的原因。

sentences.en: And this is a very consistent position all along for Karp.
sentences.zh: 这对卡普来说，一直是一个非常一致的立场。

sentences.en: It's the same view that informed his view of terrorism.
sentences.zh: 这与他看待恐怖主义的观点如出一辙。

sentences.en: If people on the left don't take concerns about public safety seriously, voters are going to turn to people on the right who do.
sentences.zh: 如果左翼人士不认真对待公共安全问题，选民就会转向重视这些问题的右翼人士。

sentences.en: And people on the left are not going to like the results.
sentences.zh: 而左翼人士是不会喜欢那种结果的。

sentences.en: He justifies the work Palantir is doing with ICE as very much fitting into this idea of securing the border, something he views as a progressive stance.
sentences.zh: 他为 Palantir 与 ICE 的合作辩护，认为这非常符合保障边境安全的理念，他将此视为一种进步派立场。

sentences.en: He does.
sentences.zh: 他确实这么认为。

sentences.en: He says at this time that he is the progressive warrior.
sentences.zh: 他当时说自己是一位进步派战士。

sentences.en: He's the true progressive.
sentences.zh: 他是真正的进步派。

sentences.en: He is doing more to defend the values that liberals claim to cherish than they are.
sentences.zh: 他在捍卫自由派声称珍视的价值观方面，做得比他们还要多。

sentences.en: He believes that Palantir, and whether it's helping enforce immigration laws or fighting terrorism, is defending liberal progressive values.
sentences.zh: 他相信 Palantir 无论是在协助执行移民法还是打击恐怖主义，都是在捍卫自由进步派的价值观。

sentences.en: But he's also stung by the criticism that he and Palantir are getting from the left, by the vitriol directed at them.
sentences.zh: 但他同时也对来自左翼的批评，以及针对他们言辞激烈的攻击感到刺痛。

sentences.en: And over time, he grows increasingly disenchanted with the Democrats and the left.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，他对比民主党和左翼越来越感到幻灭。

sentences.en: Disenchantment that grows during the Biden presidency, and that culminates with a massive event that ends up cementing his break with the Democrats,
sentences.zh: 这种幻灭感在拜登执政期间不断加剧，并最终在一场标志着他与民主党彻底决裂的重大事件中达到顶峰，

sentences.en: the October 7th terrorist attack in Israel.
sentences.zh: 那就是 10 月 7 日在以色列发生的恐怖袭击。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是 Winnalou。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的《Connections》谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是 Sam Azersky，我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 请访问 nytimes.com/games 开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: Okay, Michael.
sentences.zh: 好的，迈克尔。

sentences.en: So by the time of the October 7th attack on Israel in 2023, you'd been interviewing Alex Karp for several years.
sentences.zh: 那么，到 2023 年 10 月 7 日以色列遇袭时，你已经采访亚历克斯·卡普好几年了。

sentences.en: So how did you see him change after that moment?
sentences.zh: 在那一刻之后，你看到了他怎样的变化？

sentences.en: Well, Karp is shaken by the events of October 7th, as many people were.
sentences.zh: 嗯，和许多人一样，卡普也被 10 月 7 日发生的事件震惊了。

sentences.en: He's very supportive of Israel.
sentences.zh: 他非常支持以色列。

sentences.en: He sees Israel's security in very personal terMs.
sentences.zh: 他以非常个人的角度看待以色列的安全。

sentences.en: At one point, he had said to me that if things go sideways,
sentences.zh: 有一次他曾对我说，如果情况变糟，

sentences.en: Israel's a place I can go.
sentences.zh: 以色列是我可以去的地方。

sentences.en: So it's very much bound up in this sense of vulnerability that he feels as someone who is Jewish.
sentences.zh: 所以这与他作为一名犹太人所感受到的脆弱感紧密相连。

sentences.en: And October 7th just kind of crystallizes all these fear and sense of vulnerability.
sentences.zh: 而 10 月 7 日的事件恰好将所有这些恐惧和脆弱感具体化了。

sentences.en: He says to me at one point, this is a survival situation.
sentences.zh: 他有一次对我说，这是一场生存之战。

sentences.en: And he means that as much for himself as it is for other people.
sentences.zh: 他认为这对其他人来说，和他自己一样重要。

sentences.en: And how does his really strong reaction to this moment, to these attacks, shape Palantir's work?
sentences.zh: 那么，他对这一时刻、对这些袭击的强烈反应，是如何塑造 Palantir 的工作的？

sentences.en: There is no such thing anymore of being on all sides.
sentences.zh: 现在已经不存在所谓“各方都不得罪”的情况了。

sentences.en: Palantir only supplies its products to Western allies.
sentences.zh: Palantir 只向西方盟友提供产品。

sentences.en: I am proud that we are supporting Israel in every way we can.
sentences.zh: 我为我们能以各种方式支持以色列感到自豪。

sentences.en: Palantir already has an office in Tel Aviv.
sentences.zh: Palantir 在特拉维夫已经设有办事处。

sentences.en: Software has been used by the Mossad for a number of years.
sentences.zh: 摩萨德使用该软件已经好几年了。

sentences.en: But not long after October 7th, it sends multiple engineers there because the Israeli defense forces want to use the software.
sentences.zh: 但在 10 月 7 日之后不久，公司就派出了多名工程师前往那里，因为以色列国防军想要使用该软件。

sentences.en: There's interest from Shin Bet, which is the domestic intelligence services.
sentences.zh: 辛贝特（以色列国内安全局）也对此产生了兴趣。

sentences.en: And CARB's view is we're going to give them anything and everything they need.
sentences.zh: 卡普的观点是，我们要给他们提供他们需要的一切。

sentences.en: Palantir takes out a full-page ad in the New York Times saying that Palantir stands with Israel.
sentences.zh: Palantir 在《纽约时报》上刊登了整版广告，声明 Palantir 与以色列站在一起。

sentences.en: And this messaging is not just directed at the general public.
sentences.zh: 这种信息传递不仅是针对公众的。

sentences.en: It's also directed at Palantir employees.
sentences.zh: 它也是针对 Palantir 员工的。

sentences.en: Because he says to me privately that he wants it understood that whereas he was very willing to tolerate the dissent back during the first Trump presidency
sentences.zh: 因为他私下对我表示，他希望大家明白，虽然他在特朗普第一个任期内非常愿意容忍异议，

sentences.en: over Palantir's work with ICE, he's really not in the mood to tolerate any internal dissent over the work Palantir is doing to support Israel after October 7th.
sentences.zh: 即关于 Palantir 与 ICE 合作的异议，但他现在真的没心情容忍任何关于 Palantir 在 10 月 7 日后支持以色列工作的内部异议。

sentences.en: Have you lost employees because of this, Sam?
sentences.zh: 萨姆，你因为这件事失去员工了吗？

sentences.en: We've lost employees.
sentences.zh: 我们确实失去了员工。

sentences.en: I'm sure we'll lose employees.
sentences.zh: 我相信我们还会失去员工。

sentences.en: I'm sure we'll lose, you know, it's like if you have a position that does not cost you ever to lose an employee is not a position.
sentences.zh: 我相信我们会失去，你知道，如果你持有的立场从不需要付出失去员工的代价，那就不叫立场。

sentences.en: He says very clearly, if you can't abide by what we're doing, then maybe Palantir isn't the place for you.
sentences.zh: 他非常明确地表示，如果你不能接受我们正在做的事情，那么 Palantir 可能就不适合你。

sentences.en: And all this is in a context in which we're seeing growing protests on college campuses and elsewhere in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所有这一切都发生在我们看到美国大学校园及其他地方出现越来越多的抗议活动的背景下，

sentences.en: over Israel's response to these attacks.
sentences.zh: 抗议的内容是关于以色列对这些袭击的回应。

sentences.en: The wide-scale bombing of Gaza.
sentences.zh: 对加沙的大规模轰炸。

sentences.en: This is very much top of mind.
sentences.zh: 这非常令人关注。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And he is furious about the protests on campus.
sentences.zh: 他对校园里的抗议活动感到愤怒。

sentences.en: And I'm telling young people, you are breathing the vapors of a dangerous, new, fake, and self-destructive religion when you are sitting at your elite school
sentences.zh: 我告诉年轻人，当你们坐在精英学校里，

sentences.en: pretending because you watched TikTok twice and got an A-plus on some crazy paper that you actually understand the world.
sentences.zh: 假装因为看了两次 TikTok 并在某篇疯狂的论文中得了 A+ 就觉得自己真的了解世界时，你们呼吸的是一种危险、虚假且自毁的宗教气息。

sentences.en: He is very outspoken in the following October 7th, very outspoken about the protests on campuses, using every opportunity he can get to lash out at the protesters
sentences.zh: 他在 10 月 7 日之后非常直言不讳，对校园抗议活动直言不讳，利用一切机会抨击抗议者，

sentences.en: to say that they are delusional, that they are misguided.
sentences.zh: 说他们是在自欺欺人，说他们误入歧途。

sentences.en: And they don't see the contradiction in their behavior of writing papers about micro-discrimination and then excluding the longest existing minority overtly.
sentences.zh: 他们没有看到自己行为中的矛盾：一边写着关于微歧视的论文，一边却公然排斥历史上最古老的少数群体。

sentences.en: They literally don't see the contradiction.
sentences.zh: 他们简直看不到这种矛盾。

sentences.en: He thinks the protests are riddled with anti-Semitism and are very dangerous.
sentences.zh: 他认为这些抗议活动充斥着反犹太主义，非常危险。

sentences.en: And he sees this as reflective of a broader rot in his mind on the left.
sentences.zh: 在他看来，这反映了左翼内部更广泛的腐烂。

sentences.en: He remains supportive of President Biden.
sentences.zh: 他仍然支持拜登总统。

sentences.en: He has written checks to the Biden campaign and says he's going to continue to do so because Biden has been very supportive of the Israeli government,
sentences.zh: 他曾为拜登竞选团队捐款，并表示将继续这样做，因为拜登一直非常支持以色列政府，

sentences.en: but he's less happy with the Democratic Party in general.
sentences.zh: 但他对民主党整体不太满意。

sentences.en: He believes that the far left is the tail wagging the dog and that the far left of the Democratic Party is anti-Israel and is now becoming increasingly anti-Semitic.
sentences.zh: 他认为极左翼是“尾巴摇狗”，民主党的极左翼反以色列，并且现在正变得越来越反犹太。

sentences.en: So, this kid who grew up a lefty progressive no longer really sees himself in the progressive wing of the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 所以，这个在左翼进步派环境中长大的孩子，不再真正认为自己属于民主党的进步派阵营了。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Not all criticism of Israel is anti-Semitism, but a larger portion of it is than we realized.
sentences.zh: 并非所有对以色列的批评都是反犹太主义，但其中很大一部分确实是。

sentences.en: And we have to call it out.
sentences.zh: 我们必须指出来。

sentences.en: And he goes to an event in California, the Reagan National Defense Forum, in December 2023.
sentences.zh: 2023 年 12 月，他参加了在加州举行的里根国家国防论坛。

sentences.en: And I'm one of the largest donors to the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 我是民主党最大的捐款人之一。

sentences.en: And quite frankly,
sentences.zh: 老实说，

sentences.en: I'm calling it out and I'm giving to Republicans.
sentences.zh: 我正在指出这一点，并且我正在向共和党捐款。

sentences.en: If you keep up with this behavior,
sentences.zh: 如果你继续这种行为，

sentences.en: I'm going to change.
sentences.zh: 我会改变。

sentences.en: A lot of people like me are going to change.
sentences.zh: 像我这样的人都会改变。

sentences.en: We have to really call this out.
sentences.zh: 我们必须真正指出这一点。

sentences.en: It is completely beyond the bounds.
sentences.zh: 这完全超出了界限。

sentences.en: And he says that he wants the Democratic Party to speak in unambiguous terms, to unambiguously denounce the protesters for being anti-Semitic.
sentences.zh: 他说他希望民主党能用明确的语言说话，明确谴责抗议者的反犹太主义行为。

sentences.en: And he thinks that needs to be shut down.
sentences.zh: 他认为这必须被制止。

sentences.en: And if it's not shut down, he's saying that he's prepared to walk away from the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 如果不能制止，他说他准备离开民主党。

sentences.en: And does he make good on that threat?
sentences.zh: 他真的兑现了这个威胁吗？

sentences.en: Yes, he starts donating much more aggressively to Republicans after October 7th.
sentences.zh: 是的，10 月 7 日之后，他开始更积极地向共和党捐款。

sentences.en: And in the private conversations that he and I had, he makes clear that he is looking much more favorably on Republicans.
sentences.zh: 在我们私下的谈话中，他明确表示他现在对共和党更有好感。

sentences.en: And he's even warming to the idea of a second Trump presidency.
sentences.zh: 他甚至开始接受特朗普第二次当选总统的想法。

sentences.en: Not long after October 7th, we had a conversation and he had asked me not to record the conversation, but said I could take notes.
sentences.zh: 10 月 7 日后不久，我们进行了一次谈话，他要求我不要录音，但说我可以做笔记。

sentences.en: And Trump's name comes up and he says, and this was unprovoked, I didn't even say anything.
sentences.zh: 特朗普的名字被提到了，他说——这是他主动说的，我什么都没说——

sentences.en: And he says, I don't think Trump is a fasciSt.
sentences.zh: 他说，我不认为特朗普是法西斯主义者。

sentences.en: I don't think Trump is an anti-Semite.
sentences.zh: 我不认为特朗普是反犹太主义者。

sentences.en: I don't think Trump is a bigot.
sentences.zh: 我不认为特朗普是偏执狂。

sentences.en: It really felt like he was trying to convince himself of something.
sentences.zh: 感觉他真的在试图说服自己相信某些事情。

sentences.en: And, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，

sentences.en: it became clear to me that he believed that Trump was likely to win the 2024 election and that he was, in a sense, in a way, talking himself into getting behind that.
sentences.zh: 我很清楚他相信特朗普很可能会赢得 2024 年大选，从某种意义上说，他正在说服自己去支持这一点。

sentences.en: It's kind of wild to conceive of because, you know, you told us that in the first Trump term,
sentences.zh: 这很难想象，因为你告诉我们，在特朗普的第一个任期内，

sentences.en: Karp was very open about being against the administration, against Trump himself.
sentences.zh: 卡普非常公开地反对该政府，反对特朗普本人。

sentences.en: Do you think he was trying to talk himself into supporting Trump in part because he saw there could be just a huge business opportunity there?
sentences.zh: 你认为他试图说服自己支持特朗普，部分是因为他看到了那里可能存在巨大的商业机会吗？

sentences.en: Well, I think he certainly recognized that he was going to have to say nice things about Trump this time around.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为他肯定意识到这次他必须说些关于特朗普的好话。

sentences.en: I mean, the first rule of doing business in Donald Trump's Washington is don't piss off Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在唐纳德·特朗普的华盛顿做生意，第一条规则就是不要惹恼唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: The second rule is do everything you can to curry favor with Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 第二条规则是尽你所能去讨好唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: And if you're a major government contractor, as Palantir is, you have a particularly acute need to curry favor with Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 如果你像 Palantir 一样是主要的政府承包商，你就特别需要讨好唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: So Karp recognizes that a second Trump presidency is potentially a huge opportunity for Palantir.
sentences.zh: 所以卡普意识到，特朗普的第二个任期对 Palantir 来说可能是一个巨大的机会。

sentences.en: And he writes a million-dollar check to the Trump-Vance
sentences.zh: 他给特朗普-万斯就职委员会写了一张一百万美元的支票，

sentences.en: Inauguration Committee, and Palantir lands a number of deals during the first months of Trump's second presidency.
sentences.zh: Palantir 在特朗普第二个任期的头几个月里达成了一系列交易。

sentences.en: Its software is used extensively by Doge.
sentences.zh: 其软件被“政府效率部”（Doge）广泛使用。

sentences.en: It gets a $10 billion contract with the army, and it also gets another contract with ICE, this one for $30 million to help with deportations.
sentences.zh: 它获得了陆军一份 100 亿美元的合同，还获得了 ICE 的另一份合同，价值 3000 万美元，用于协助驱逐出境。

sentences.en: And amid all this
sentences.zh: 在这一切之中，

sentences.en: I'll tell you something I think Trump does very, very well.
sentences.zh: 我告诉你一件我认为特朗普做得非常、非常好的一件事。

sentences.en: He says,
sentences.zh: 他说，

sentences.en: I'm not going to accept a paradigm that essentially leads to a stupid conclusion.
sentences.zh: 我不会接受一个本质上会导致愚蠢结论的范式。

sentences.en: Karp starts publicly singing Trump's praises.
sentences.zh: 卡普开始公开歌颂特朗普。

sentences.en: Honestly, I think he's quite brilliant at this.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我认为他在这一点上非常聪明。

sentences.en: Saying lots of nice things about Donald Trump in public.
sentences.zh: 在公开场合说了很多关于唐纳德·特朗普的好话。

sentences.en: I'm very supportive of the president's border and national security thing is really the only two things that I actually focus on.
sentences.zh: 我非常支持总统的边境和国家安全政策，这确实是我唯一关注的两件事。

sentences.en: And I guess in that sense, I support the president a lot.
sentences.zh: 我想从这个意义上说，我非常支持总统。

sentences.en: He says that on the issues that are of paramount concern to him now, the border and national security, he thinks that Trump is doing a great job.
sentences.zh: 他说，在他现在最关心的边境和国家安全问题上，他认为特朗普做得很好。

sentences.en: Like getting the peace deal, closing the border, degrading Iran, our world historic accomplishments, and I don't see why you wouldn't acknowledge that.
sentences.zh: 比如达成和平协议、关闭边境、削弱伊朗，这些都是世界历史性的成就，我不明白你为什么不承认这一点。

sentences.en: And when confronted during interviews, if this represents a big shift in his own position, he insists no.
sentences.zh: 当在采访中被问及这是否代表他自身立场的重大转变时，他坚称没有。

sentences.en: I didn't shift my politics.
sentences.zh: 我没有改变我的政治立场。

sentences.en: The political parties have shifted their politics.
sentences.zh: 是政党改变了他们的政治立场。

sentences.en: The idea that what's being called progressive is in any way progressive is a complete farce.
sentences.zh: 所谓进步派的东西在任何方面都是进步的，这完全是一场闹剧。

sentences.en: He continues to insist that he's a true progressive and he thinks that the left has stopped being progressive.
sentences.zh: 他继续坚持自己是真正的进步派，并认为左翼已经不再进步了。

sentences.en: I grew up in a highly intellectual, mostly Jewish, incredibly left-wing environment.
sentences.zh: 我在一个高度知识化、大多数是犹太人、极其左翼的环境中长大。

sentences.en: And every Saturday and every Friday, I heard a lecture about how the conservatives are going to destroy this country with illegal immigration because it's going to undermine
sentences.zh: 每个周六和周五，我都会听到关于保守派将如何通过非法移民摧毁这个国家的讲座，因为它会破坏

sentences.en: the fabric of the American worker.
sentences.zh: 美国工人的根基。

sentences.en: That's what it means to be a progressive.
sentences.zh: 这就是成为进步派的意义。

sentences.en: So, I want to ask, given the trajectory that you've sketched out for us of this incredibly powerful company,
sentences.zh: 所以，我想问，考虑到你为我们勾勒出的这家极其强大的公司的发展轨迹，

sentences.en: Palantir, being driven, at least in part, by the evolution of its CEO,
sentences.zh: Palantir 的发展，至少在一定程度上，是由其首席执行官的演变所驱动的，

sentences.en: CARP, we've been talking about the work that Palantir does as being influenced by CARP's personal politics, but I have to ask, do you see his journey from anti-Trump to now all-in
sentences.zh: Karp，我们一直在讨论 Palantir 的工作受到 Karp 个人政治立场的影响，但我不得不问，你认为他从反特朗普到如今全力支持

sentences.en: on the administration as purely ideological?
sentences.zh: 现任政府的转变，纯粹是出于意识形态吗？

sentences.en: Or is it about money?
sentences.zh: 还是为了钱？

sentences.en: Because the shift has obviously been incredibly profitable for the company.
sentences.zh: 因为这种转变显然让公司获利颇丰。

sentences.en: It's a combination of the two and what proportion of each I can't really say.
sentences.zh: 这是两者结合的结果，至于各占多少比例，我真的说不好。

sentences.en: I will say this.
sentences.zh: 但我可以这么说。

sentences.en: One of the things that makes CARP such an interesting figure is opportunism isn't good enough for him.

sentences.en: He has to find an ideological reason, something personal slash ideological to really get on board with something.
sentences.zh: 他必须找到一个意识形态上的理由，某种个人加意识形态的理由，才能真正全身心投入某件事。

sentences.en: It can't just be opportunism.
sentences.zh: 不能仅仅是机会主义。

sentences.en: You see with a number of major tech executives have gotten on board with Trump the second time around and with some of them, the cravenness drips off them like sweat.
sentences.zh: 你看，许多大型科技公司高管在特朗普第二次竞选时都选择了支持他，对于其中一些人来说，那种卑躬屈膝简直像汗水一样从他们身上滴落。

sentences.en: CARP is a little different.
sentences.zh: Karp 有点不同。

sentences.en: He has found reasons to get on board with Trump, reasons in his own mind, reasons that go beyond necessity and opportunism.
sentences.zh: 他找到了支持特朗普的理由，在他自己的内心深处，这些理由超越了必要性和机会主义。

sentences.en: He thinks Trump is the right guy.

sentences.en: On the issues he says he cares about, immigration for example, does he engage at all on the questions that people are raising
sentences.zh: 在他声称关心的议题上，比如移民问题，他是否参与讨论了人们提出的质疑，

sentences.en: the data that it has on the people in this country to, you know, snatch people off the streets, break up families, that kind of thing?
sentences.zh: 即利用公司掌握的全国人口数据，你知道，去街上抓人、拆散家庭之类的事情？

sentences.en: He doesn't really want to talk about them and he deflects them by saying that I and other people just have Trump derangement syndrome.

sentences.en: Meaning what?

sentences.en: Meaning that the people who are raising these issues, raising these concerns are just so hostile to Trump, so blinded with rage at Trump that they can't think
sentences.zh: 意思是那些提出这些问题和担忧的人，对特朗普太怀有敌意了，被对特朗普的愤怒冲昏了头脑，以至于无法

sentences.en: rationally about these issues.
sentences.zh: 理性地思考这些问题。

sentences.en: But I also know that Karp's views on immigration have changed and this goes back to October 7th.
sentences.zh: 但我也知道 Karp 对移民的看法已经改变了，这要追溯到 10 月 7 日。

sentences.en: Before October 7th, he saw the immigration issue, he saw the chaos at the border as bad for the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 在 10 月 7 日之前，他认为移民问题和边境混乱对民主党不利。

sentences.en: After October 7th, he also sees the immigration issue and the border as bad for American Jews.
sentences.zh: 在 10 月 7 日之后，他也认为移民问题和边境问题对美国犹太人不利。

sentences.en: Because he thinks it's poking the bear that an uncontrolled border,
sentences.zh: 因为他认为这就像是在捅马蜂窝，不受控制的边境，

sentences.en: lots of illegal immigration is radicalizing Americans against diversity, which he sees as really bad for the Jews.
sentences.zh: 大量的非法移民正在激化美国人对多元化的反感，他认为这对犹太人非常不利。

sentences.en: Because if voters want the border controlled and a democratically elected government doesn't deliver on what they want, they may turn to more radical solutions.
sentences.zh: 因为如果选民想要控制边境，而民选政府无法满足他们的要求，他们可能会转向更激进的解决方案。

sentences.en: The backlash next time may be even more severe and people might turn to a genuine autocrat, which would be, in Karp's view, really bad for the Jews.
sentences.zh: 下一次的反弹可能会更加严重，人们可能会转向真正的独裁者，在 Karp 看来，这对犹太人来说将是非常糟糕的。

sentences.en: It's worth noting that there are people who believe that Donald Trump, while democratically elected, is leaning toward
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，有些人认为唐纳德·特朗普虽然是民选产生的，但他自己也倾向于

sentences.en: autocratic tactics himself.
sentences.zh: 独裁手段。

sentences.en: And it sounds like
sentences.zh: 听起来

sentences.en: Karp doesn't believe that.
sentences.zh: Karp 并不相信这一点。

sentences.en: He believes there are many worse options out there.
sentences.zh: 他认为外面还有很多更糟糕的选择。

sentences.en: He pushes back furiously against any suggestion that Trump is an autocrat or a fasciSt.
sentences.zh: 他强烈反驳任何关于特朗普是独裁者或法西斯主义者的说法。

sentences.zh: 例如，在最近接受《泰晤士报》安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金采访时……

sentences.zh: 好吧，我想问你这个问题，这是一个关于特朗普的问题。

sentences.zh: 有一种观点，我很好奇你的立场。

sentences.zh: 你认为

sentences.zh: 特朗普总统是法西斯主义者吗？

sentences.zh: 当然不是。

sentences.en: I think that's stupid.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那很愚蠢。

sentences.zh: 说真的。

sentences.en: It's honestly idiotic.
sentences.zh: 这简直是白痴行为。

sentences.zh: 他说任何暗示特朗普是法西斯主义者的说法都是愚蠢的。

sentences.zh: 我在德国度过了半辈子。

sentences.zh: 我和真正的法西斯分子打过交道。

sentences.en: I went and talked to lots of former Nazis.
sentences.zh: 我曾去和许多前纳粹分子交谈过。

sentences.en: We have a democratic society, and you know, he won in a landslide.
sentences.zh: 我们拥有一个民主社会，而且你知道，他是以压倒性优势获胜的。

sentences.en: I don't...

sentences.en: I'm thinking specifically in this case of Nick Fuentes, the white nationalist who is apparently quite popular with young conservative men in particular.
sentences.zh: 我这里特别指的是尼克·富恩特斯，那个白人至上主义者，他显然在年轻保守派男性中非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: Yes, we've discussed it, and he has admitted to being concerned about it.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们讨论过，他也承认对此感到担忧。

sentences.en: And I think this goes some way to explaining why he is so ardently behind
sentences.zh: 我认为这在一定程度上解释了他为何如此热衷于支持

sentences.en: Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: Because, again, he fears that if Trump doesn't deliver on his campaign promises, particularly on immigration, that what's going to come after this could be even worse.
sentences.zh: 因为，还是那句话，他担心如果特朗普不能兑现竞选承诺，特别是在移民问题上，那么接下来可能会发生更糟糕的事情。

sentences.en: That a demagogue in the mold of a Fuentes or someone like that could come to power, which Karp thinks would be very bad for the country.

sentences.en: And I think he sees the work that Palantir is doing with the Trump administration as preventive in nature in some sense.
sentences.zh: 我认为他将 Palantir 与特朗普政府的合作视为一种预防性的举措。

sentences.en: Just to step back,
sentences.zh: 退一步说，

sentences.en: Michael, you've described this evolution of Karp, a guy who grew up as a progressive and is now out defending Trump on some of his most aggressive policies.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，你描述了 Karp 的这种演变，一个成长为进步派的人，现在却在为特朗普的一些最激进的政策辩护。

sentences.en: I'm wondering how we should think about the fact that Karp is running a company that essentially enables Trump's work.
sentences.zh: 我想知道我们该如何看待 Karp 经营着一家本质上为特朗普的工作提供支持的公司这一事实。

sentences.en: Do you think that Karp can accurately assess when the Trump administration's policies potentially tip over into violating people's civil liberties or potentially become more
sentences.zh: 你认为 Karp 能准确评估特朗普政府的政策何时可能越界侵犯公民自由，或可能变得更

sentences.en: authoritarian in nature?
sentences.zh: 具有威权主义色彩吗？

sentences.en: Like, do you think
sentences.zh: 比如，你认为

sentences.en: Karp would be willing to do basically anything the Trump administration wants his company to do or not?
sentences.zh: Karp 会愿意做特朗普政府要求他公司做的任何事情吗？

sentences.en: I don't know the answer to that, which is kind of unsettling.
sentences.zh: 我不知道答案，这让人感到不安。

sentences.en: I've been talking to him for six years.
sentences.zh: 我和他谈了六年了。

sentences.en: He expresses very strongly held views on a range of issues, but he has not said to me in private, nor has he said publicly, what his red lines are, what things

sentences.en: the Trump administration might do that would cause him to reconsider
sentences.zh: 是特朗普政府可能做出的，会让他重新考虑

sentences.zh: Palantir 与政府的合作。
